name: OmaMovie
author: tenzin
description: Install: mpv + gh (fast attested download, <5s) or cargo (fallback build). Use: omarchy plugin add https://github.com/yesheytenzin/omamovie.git --enable → click  → search in Discover/Search → pick title → choose season/episode & stream (resolution/codec/size) → Play opens mpv (subs auto-downloaded, panel closes). Update: omarchy plugin update tenzin.omamovie | Remove: omarchy plugin remove tenzin.omamovie
